title: Band Tribute Booklet
summary: A typographic editorial booklet celebrating the visual identity of a selected band. The project focused on creating a cohesive publication system that translated the band's music and personality into print through hierarchy, pacing, imagery, and expressive typography.

overview.challenge: Rather than simply documenting the band, the goal was to balance readability with a strong visual atmosphere while maintaining consistency across every spread.
overview.solution: I built a restrained editorial system around cream, charcoal, and burgundy, pairing serif typography with archival imagery, handwritten textures, and a clear grid.
overview.outcome: The 16-page booklet celebrates Billy Joel’s introspective songwriting through a cinematic sequence of spreads, lyrics, discography, and archival references rather than a conventional commercial portrait.

blocks.label: 01 — Sketches
blocks.heading: Setting the editorial tone
blocks.body: Early studies explored serif type, archival album packaging, and music journalism from the 1970s and early 1980s. I tested grid structures and spread pacing to make room for lyrics and imagery without losing the intimacy of the subject.
